newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation 0.16 pct Feb 22-March 23.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation 0.16 pct Feb 22-March 23.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was unchanged at 0.16 percent between February 22 and March 23 against the previous four week period, a Fipe official said.
Fipe inflation index coordinator Juarez Rizzieri, said total accumulated inflation for March would be of around 0.2 percent.
Rizzieri released the following breakdown of Fipe's weighted inflation index for February 22 through March 23.
- Food: 1.48 pct rise in the month
- Housing: 0.32 pct rise in the month
- Transportation: -0.22 pct drop in the month
- Personal expenses: -0.02 pct drop in the month
- Clothing: -4.20 pct drop in the month
- Health care: -0.46 pct drop in the month
- Education: 0.22 pct drop in the month
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures weekly.
